string.name: text
string.value: You traveled to Ereve in search of Olive and the Seal Stone.

string.name: text
string.value: When you confronted her, Olive adamantly denied having anything to do with the Seal Stone. She blamed someone called the 'Master of Disguise.'

string.name: text
string.value: You thought maybe she was telling the truth, but before you could decide, someone from the Thieves Guild arrived and snatched Olive away.

string.name: text
string.value: As she was being dragged off, Olive begged you to talk to Neinheart in Ereve to find proof of her innocence.

string.name: text
string.value: Neinheart confirmed that the 'Master of Disguise' did in fact exist and that his disguises were flawless.

string.name: text
string.value: But now you wondered, who in Maple World was this so-called Master of Disguise?
